subject: Taxes
title: The Boston Tea Party
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Boston Tea Party.

hook.text: On December 16, 1773, colonists dumped 342 chests of tea into Boston Harbor.

buildup.text: The Tea Act let the East India Company sell tea directly, undercutting local merchants.

discovery.text: The Sons of Liberty, disguised as Mohawk Indians, boarded three ships.

twist.text: Britain responded with the Intolerable Acts, closing Boston Harbor.

climax.text: The Boston Tea Party turned a tax protest into a revolution. It showed that overreaction to protest escalates conflict.

punchline.text: 342 chests of tea. One revolution. The tax was just the start.

quiz.question: How much tea was destroyed during the Boston Tea Party?
